tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: Search for makeup artists and beauty professionals on Sharaloge by location (state, city, LGA, neighborhood in Nigeria), specialty, price range, and rating. Use this to answer questions like 'find me a makeup artist in Lagos'.

tools.name: get_artist_profile
tools.description: Get the full profile of a single Sharaloge artist by ID, including portfolio, pricing tiers, specialties, ratings and reviews.

tools.name: reserve_booking
tools.description: Create a booking reservation with a Sharaloge artist for a given date and time. Requires the customer to be authenticated with a Sharaloge account (authToken).
